scope: Local wardrobe persistence, favorites, names, preferences and actionable studio guidance

features.wardrobe_storage: IndexedDB; normalized garment reference blobs only

limits: Wardrobe belongs to the same browser and origin; clearing site data removes it
No cloud account or cross-device synchronization
Camera and generated frames are not persisted in the wardrobe
No remote GPU started and no new real-person inference performance measurement
No claim that motion artifacts, back-view pattern correctness or remote latency are fixed
Word documents were not regenerated in this UI iteration
